description: Ex-RAF WA452, RNZAF instructional airframe INST203; the long-standing gate guardian at RNZAF Base Ohakea, in place since at least 1976. Inside the wire, so viewing depends on base access.
Composite Skyhawk restoration project given the notional serial NZ6257; recorded by adf-serials as an outside display at Ohakea.

Manufacturer's no. 04396. Arrived at Wigram 13 April 1953, served with No. 42 Squadron at Ohakea, became instructional airframe INST216 at Woodbourne in 1981, transferred to MOTAT in 2010 and returned to Ohakea in August 2018 on loan from the Air Force Museum of New Zealand.
